title: The Friday of the Sealed Envelope
skyStory: The moon slips into Scorpio, just under half lit and wearing a long dark coat with too many pockets. Scorpio loves a secret, a mystery, a sealed envelope with no return address. Tonight it has one of each. The waning half moon hides its face behind a gloved hand and says, darkly, that some truths are better whispered. Mars leans in. Saturn takes notes.

reading: Scorpio dares you to be honest about one small thing today. Not a confession, just a truth: I need help with this, or I really liked what you did, or that idea does not work for me. Say it plainly, once, without padding. The Tiger is braver than it thinks.

This evening, write a letter to yourself to open on your birthday in March. Seal it. Write the date on the outside. Do not tell anyone what is inside. [[Judgement]] sounds a quiet trumpet, calling the next version of you forward. Equinox Joel will be glad you wrote it.
joel.mission: Write yourself a sealed letter to open on March 21, then tuck it where you will not stumble on it.
joel.omen: A dark envelope or parcel on a doorstep. It means a good surprise is on its way to you before spring.

reading: The shore at night is Scorpio's favourite place, black water and silver ice, everything mysterious. Today your Life Path 11 intuition is basically a searchlight sweeping the dark. You will see right through one situation and know exactly what is going on. Trust it.

The [[Eight of Swords]] tries to whisper that you are stuck. You are not. The blindfold is loose, and the swords are just painted cardboard. Take one step out of the cage today, any small step, and notice that nothing stops you. Scorpio cheers in its very quiet way, which is a single raised eyebrow.
nancy.mission: Take one small step out of a rut today, a new route, a new question, a new chair, and notice how easy it was.
nancy.omen: Your own footprints in fresh snow, leading away from the house. It means you are already further along than you feel.

together.text: Each of you tells the other one small true thing you have not said out loud yet. It can be silly, like a secret favourite word, or real, like a hope for spring. Scorpio guarantees safe passage. The rule: the listener only answers, thank you for telling me.
